title: Ohm’s Law: Resistance and Simple Circuits

changes.local: an empirical relation stating that the current I is proportional to the potential difference V. It is often written as I = V/R, where R is the resistance

changes.local: This is a relatively small resistance, but it is larger than the cold resistance of the headlight. Resistance usually increases with temperature, and so the bulb has a lower resistance when it is first switched on and will draw considerably more current during its brief warm-up period.
